articles.title: Alleged Kimwolf Botmaster ‘Dort’ Arrested, Charged in U.S. and Canada
articles.summary: CISA contractor accidentally turned GitHub into a government secrets buffet, exposing AWS GovCloud keys like breadcrumbs for any script kiddie with an internet connection. The agency tasked with protecting our infrastructure just served it up on a silver platter.

articles.title: Patch Tuesday, May 2026 Edition
articles.summary: Plot twist: the same CISA breach story but with more delicious technical details about how a cybersecurity agency managed to be less secure than a teenager's TikTok account. AWS GovCloud credentials scattered across GitHub like digital confetti.

articles.title: Microsoft Took a Step Toward Human Rights Accountability. Google and Amazon (and Others) Should Pay Attention!
articles.summary: EFF celebrates a rare victory for end-to-end encryption, proving that sometimes the good guys actually win one against the surveillance state. Your dick pics remain safe from government eyes, for now.

articles.title: Akamai Joins Growing Chorus of Vendors Betting Big on Secure Enterprise Browsers
articles.summary: EFF drops a new guide on fighting digital surveillance because apparently we need instruction manuals to resist becoming a panopticon dystopia. Spoiler alert: the surveillance state won't police itself.

articles.title: AI Agents Are Shifting Identity Security Budget Dynamics
articles.summary: Google's API keys have the digital equivalent of zombie persistence, staying active for 23 minutes after 'deletion' like undead authentication tokens. Even Google can't properly kill their own access credentials.

articles.title: TrapDoor Supply Chain Attack Spreads Credential-Stealing Malware via npm, PyPI, and CratesIO
articles.summary: Trump Mobile leaked customer data faster than you can say 'covfefe,' proving that MAGA merchandise extends to hilariously insecure tech products. Thousands of supporters got their personal info served up via basic HTTP requests.

articles.title: Laravel-Lang PHP Packages Compromised to Deliver Cross-Platform Credential Stealer
articles.summary: Anthropic's Claude AI went full terminator on software security, discovering 10,000 high-severity vulnerabilities in systemically important code. The machines are now better at finding ways to break other machines than humans ever were.

articles.title: The Trump Phone Appears to Have Already Leaked Its Customers’ Personal Information Through a Glaring Exploit
articles.summary: TeamPCP pulled off an epic supply chain heist, stealing 4,000 GitHub repos through a poisoned VS Code extension and exposing the house-of-cards nature of modern software security. When your IDE becomes an IED, trust nothing.

articles.title: Trump Mobile data leak exposes only 30,000 orders, far below earlier claims of 600,000
articles.summary: Talos Intelligence explores the beautiful art of professional ungovernability, teaching security researchers how to be productive rebels who challenge authority without getting fired. Required reading for anyone tired of corporate security theater.

articles.title: Companies Using Anthropic's Mythos AI Uncover 10K+ Serious Software Bugs
articles.summary: CISA adds another Drupal Core vulnerability to their Known Exploited Vulnerabilities catalog, because apparently content management systems are as secure as wet paper bags. Time to patch your WordPress sites while you're at it.
